          display: none; // removes caption but keeps alt text

          margin-bottom: 0px; // removes spacing under images
        }
        .grid-item--width2 { width: 320px; }
        .grid-item--width3 { width: 480px; }
        .grid-item--width4 { width: 640px; }

        .grid-item--height2 { height: 200px; }
        .grid-item--height3 { height: 260px; }
        .grid-item--height4 { height: 360px; }

The below images show some of the results created along my daily basis. This process includes data exploration, pattern identification, network analysis or prediction, informed decision analysis and functional exploration of the results.

![Estructura de actinomicina D](images/actinomycin.png){.lightbox}

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| message: false
img_meta <- readr::read_delim("image-meta.csv", delim = ";", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
img_files <- img_meta$img_path
img_captions <- img_meta$alt_text
cat(
  glue::glue("
    :::{{.grid-item}}
    ![{img_captions}](images/{img_files}){{group='sketches'}}
    :::"),
  sep = "\n"
)
```
